title: Define next-step community-recorded audio workflow for non-TTS languages
notes:
Split out of ISSUE-0016 on 2026-05-23 after narrowing ISSUE-0016 to Kok Kaper no-audio/skip-TTS fallback validation only. This issue tracks definition/design of the next-step community-recorded audio workflow for non-TTS languages (data model, roles/permissions, moderation, recording UX, storage/versioning, and integration into audio annotation/compile). See docs/roadmap/low-resource-languages.md section 5.2 for detailed roadmap context.

Human issue-review update from Manny Rayner on 2026-08-13: Community-recorded audio is important for Indigenous-language work and is needed for the planned ComputEL-10 paper (deadline early October, exact date not yet confirmed). Sophie needs it as soon as possible; having an initial usable workflow before her 24 August community visit would be very valuable.
